description: Ask the team questions about an item. Ask 1–4 structured questions about a queue item — the way to get a decision from a person when the implementation needs one. Each question is the `AskUserQuestion` shape: a short `header` chip, the full `question`, 2–4 `options` (`label` + `description`), and `multiSelect` (ch…

agent.description: The agent type asking — pass your own type when you are a coding agent. Defaults to the run's agent.

delivery.description: How the answer gets back to the asker — `resume` re-fires the asking run's trigger connector on the item once every question that run asked is answered; `poll` fires nothing and the asker reads `GET .../questions`.

handle.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

items.description: One question to ask — the `AskUserQuestion` shape.

header.description: Very short chip label for the question (max 24 chars), e.g. `Auth method`.

multiSelect.description: `true` lets the person pick several options (checkboxes); `false` (the default) exactly one (radios).

options.description: 2–4 distinct choices. Do not add an "Other" option — a free-text answer is always offered.

items.description: One choice offered by a question — rendered as a radio, or a checkbox when the question is `multiSelect`.

description.description: What picking this option means — its trade-off or consequence.

label.description: The option's display text — short (1–5 words). Answers name options by this label.

question.description: The complete question, ending with a question mark (markdown).

runId.description: The run (investigation record id) you are working the item under — the `runId` an ack or a launch handed you. Ties the questions to that run so a `resume` delivery continues it.

name: ops_questions_ask
